$jsonSchema.title: PaymentReconciliationItem
$jsonSchema.description: Stage 8 — one document per payment per reconciliation run. Records the three-way tie-out (payment↔rail, rail↔settlement, settlement↔GL) Doina's L640-644 asks for, the per-leg match/mismatch result, and the overall outcome. Authored here because the collection is named at L745/L926 and never specified — 0 matches in the canonical spec (verified by count). Ratify via Q56.

reconciliationItemId.description: RI-… derive_ref('RI', oid). FK target of payments.refs.reconciliationItemId.

legs.description: Exactly three legs, in Doina's L642-644 order: PAYMENT_RAIL, RAIL_SETTLEMENT, SETTLEMENT_GL.

overallResult.description: RECONCILED only when every leg is MATCH or NOT_APPLICABLE. DISCREPANT if any leg MISMATCH. PENDING if any leg is not yet checkable (retried next batch).

journalEntryId.description: The settlement (or principal, for a book transfer) journal that proves leg 3.

settlementPositionId.description: The settlementPositions doc that proves leg 2. Null for a book transfer.
